t: Japan Rabbit | How to buy from Square Enix
s: The hard part is deciding what goodies you want to buy. But once you’ve decided, telling us what you want is the easy part! Simply go to the Japan Rabbit app and put the URL of the product page on Square Enix’s website into the field that asks for it. To get the URL, you can highlight the link on the page’s address bar, right-click with your mouse and select copy, or Ctrl+C on your keyboard.
